scripts.build: pnpm --filter @mstream/contracts build && pnpm --filter @mstream/api build && pnpm --filter @mstream/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @mstream/contracts build && pnpm --filter @mstream/api typecheck && pnpm --filter @mstream/web typecheck
scripts.format: pnpm exec prettier --write eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json && pnpm --filter @mstream/api format && pnpm --filter @mstream/web format
scripts.format:check: pnpm exec prettier --check eslint.config.mjs .prettierrc.json && pnpm --filter @mstream/api format:check && pnpm --filter @mstream/web format:check
